name: Perchli Property Search
description: Perchli 连接买家与北爱尔兰房地产经纪人。该 MCP 插件可按地点、价格、卧室数、类型、EPC 和设施搜索实时房源，获取具体房源的价格、产权、EPC、费率、设施、营销代理和照片；也可基于官方 LPS/NISRA 北爱尔兰房价指数回答平均或典型价格，并用收入、首付和实时英格兰银行利率估算预算及月供。所有工具匿名且只读：无需登录，不收集个人数据，不预订也不改变状态。可负担性数字仅供参考，不构成金融建议；看房请求会转交 Perchli 应用供用户确认。

name: Peristyle Grocery Cart
description:
该插件将食谱变成购物车。以下功能和限制适用：

Peristyle turns a recipe into a ready-to-checkout grocery cart. Search  a recipe, and it pulls the ingredient list, matches each item to real products at Kroger or  Walmart, and shows you the options — with size, price, and brand — before anything is added to a cart. Connect your Kroger account once to shop directly through the assistant, or use Walmart's catalog with no sign-in at all. Peristyle remembers your default store, pickup or delivery preference, dietary needs, and preferred brands, so repeat shopping gets faster over time.
You always see and approve product matches before they're added — Peristyle fills the cart
but never places the order or handles payment. Checkout happens on Kroger's or Walmart's own site.

name: Perk
description:
该插件规划行程并管理支出。以下功能和限制适用：
Perk brings your business travel and spend into ChatGPT. Plan and review trips, check bookings, track spend, and pull travel and expense reports - all without leaving the conversation. Built for Perk customers who want fast answers from their own travel and spend data.

description:

Petco Shopping Assistant helps pet parents discover, select, and add pet essentials to their cart using natural language. The assistant recommends products, supports new pet adoption preparation, and guides customers toward appropriate food, toys, grooming supplies, non-prescription health and wellness supplies, and other pet products available at Petco. Payment, final checkout, and order completion happen outside ChatGPT on Petco's external checkout experience.

description: Placer.ai Pi 回答基于现实世界测量行为的商业问题。用自然语言提出完整分析问题，Pi 会运行完整的 Placer.ai 分析——客流趋势、访客人口统计和旅程、商圈、交叉购物以及销售和支出——然后返回书面答案、数据诚实性注意事项、使用的网页来源，以及一个深度链接，在 Pi 中打开相同分析和交互式地图。完整分析通常需要几分钟：ask_pi 启动分析并返回句柄，get_pi_result 收集答案并在运行期间报告进度。典型工作流包括门店和组合表现、商圈和选址分析、竞争基准、租户组合和联合租赁审查、市场可行性，以及品类或市场份额跟踪。后续问题可以复用之前的分析，确保对话中的数字保持一致。访问需要拥有 Pi 和 MCP 访问权限的 Placer.ai 账户；Pi 只返回登录的 Placer 用户有权查看的数据。

name: Piazza in Festa
summary: 意大利城镇活动与集市
description: Piazza in Festa 回答意大利城镇正在发生的活动，包括乡村节庆、主保圣人节、食品和葡萄酒集市、街市、音乐会和展览。目录每天根据市政厅依法发布的官方登记公告重建，因此也覆盖其他日历不会列出的小城镇。用户可以按城镇、地区、类别、自由文本或日期范围搜索，打开单个活动查看日期、地点和主办方等实用详情，并询问某个地区覆盖哪些城镇。每个结果都带有活动页面链接和据此生成的官方文件链接，方便核验。

name: Pillr
description: Pillr 免费提供无需登录的法国房地产公共数据：任何市镇的每平方米价格、市场摘要（租金、收益率、价格趋势、分区），以及翻修项目所需的许可或申报要求。每个数字均来自官方公共数据（DVF、DHUP、INSEE）和法国城市规划法；不会显示房源、地址或专有评分。

name: Pixelixe
description:
该插件创建和编辑图形。以下功能和限制适用：
Connect your Pixelixe account to find saved documents, inspect a design, create a new graphic from scratch, or generate a new variant from an existing document. Pixelixe is useful for social posts, promos, event graphics, and other reusable marketing visuals. New outputs are saved to your Pixelixe workspace so you can open them in Studio and keep editing.

name: PKB Immobilien
description:
该插件Baunatal 和 Kassel 房产。以下功能和限制适用：

PKB Immobilien is a locally focused real estate company specializing in Baunatal, Kassel, the Kassel district, and the Schwalm-Eder district. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties throughout the region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand location, infrastructure, and the surrounding neighborhood at a glance, making the property search simpler and more efficient.

Combining in-depth local market knowledge with personal advice, PKB Immobilien connects modern digital solutions with regional real estate expertise. Buyers, sellers, and investors gain transparent and convenient access to the property market in Baunatal, Kassel, and the surrounding region.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map view
* Quick orientation across Baunatal, Kassel, and Northern Hesse
* Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
* Focus on selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different locations and municipalities
* More efficient property searches through visual navigation
* Local market expertise and personalized real estate advice
* Modern and user-friendly access to the regional property market
Whether you are looking for an apartment in Kassel, a family home in Baunatal, a property in the Kassel district, or an attractive investment property in the Schwalm-Eder district, PKB Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and regionally focused way to access the local real estate market.

name: Plasmole
description:
该插件设计、编辑并注释 DNA。以下功能和限制适用：
Plasmole brings deterministic molecular-biology tools into ChatGPT. Annotate raw DNA (ORF and parts detection), parse GenBank/FASTA files, edit and assemble sequences, design and visualize PCR primers, find restriction sites and predict digests, calculate melting temperature, design CRISPR guides, optimize codons, align two or many sequences, verify a clone against its reference, check a design for problems, export GenBank or FASTA, and fetch public NCBI records by accession, or resolve a gene, plasmid or vector name to one. Plasmid-producing tools render an interactive circular map inline; drag-select a region to design primers against it. Constructs are versioned, so you can compare or restore any earlier snapshot. For research use only.

description:

PokeBot adds purpose-built career-readiness workflows to ChatGPT. It evaluates your resume and interview answers against role-specific criteria, returning structured scores, evidence-backed gaps, and prioritized next steps instead of relying on one-off career prompts.
Match your resume against a job description, re-score it after edits to see what improved, run mock interviews with feedback on every answer, draft tailored cover letters, map your skill gaps, and build week-by-week growth plans. PokeBot covers quantitative finance, AI/ML, software engineering, data science, product management, finance, and more.

name: Poster Maker
description:
该插件设计海报和传单。以下功能和限制适用：
Poster Maker helps you turn your ideas into professional posters without leaving the chat.
Simply describe what you need—a birthday invitation, restaurant offer, festival greeting, business promotion, event flyer, or social media post—and Poster Maker searches its template library to find the best matching designs. It displays personalized previews directly in ChatGPT instead of generic samples.
Add details such as a name, date, price, discount, contact number, or business information, and Poster Maker automatically places your content into the selected design so you can see how the final poster will look.
Once you've found the design you like, open it in the Poster App Lab editor to customize colors, fonts, images, and layout, then download and share your finished poster anywhere.

Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

description:
该插件GTM 与营销自动化。以下功能和限制适用：

Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.
The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

description:
该插件发现并规划住宿。以下功能和限制适用：

Discover and plan your Radisson stay, now directly in ChatGPT.

Just describe what you’re looking for, and the app helps you search and compare Radisson properties with up-to-date rates, location context, and practical hotel details. You can explore results on an interactive map, quickly understand which options are closest to the places that matter to you, and compare hotels by price, amenities, and overall fit without jumping between multiple tabs.

Whether you’re planning far ahead or figuring things out last minute, you can refine your search in seconds by adjusting destination, dates, budget, or preferences as you chat. The experience is designed to keep planning easy from start to finish: ask, compare, narrow down, and choose with confidence.

Try prompts like:
 - Find Radisson hotels near downtown Amsterdam for next weekend
 - Show options with breakfast included and a fitness center
 - Get me the best-value stays near the airport
 - Which Radisson hotel is best for walkable dining and shopping?
When you’re ready, just select the option you like, and the app gives you a direct booking link to complete your Radisson reservation with ease. No payment is processed within ChatGPT.
